algorithms.flow_direction: Track B (undirected→directed): check-valve glyphs (▷| seat-bar gated, min_area=200, seat<= 15px) + arrowheads (area 200-2000px², solidity>=0.85, <=30px from pipe) -> seed (check-valve wins conflicts) -> BFS propagate through degree-2 junctions (stop at degree>2 SPLIT/MERGE and equipment) -> equipment boundary conventions (compressor L-in/R-out, vessel bottom-out) -> dead-leg topology pass (single connected end => flow toward it; category-A noise stubs and category-B signal lines excluded). DETERMINISTIC layer = 51/389 directed (45 CV/propagation/convention + 6 topology_dead_end); drawing lacks dense machine-readable flow. GATED Gemini fallback (--gemini-flow-fallback) resolves category-D pipelines (candidates + both ends connected) via ~6 spatial-cluster vision calls -> evidence='gemini_vision' (this file: 0 resolved).
algorithms.signal_hierarchy: Track C (control loops): dashed signal lines detected by proximity-gated strict path-probing (pairs within 850px; a path is a signal edge only if fully on a dashed line — coverage 0.12-0.85, >=4 ink/gap transitions, none solid). Edges added as category='signal' rel='SIGNAL_TO'; they fix is_isolated (Option A) but are EXCLUDED from process rooting BFS (Decision A2). control_loops[] = signal connected-components capped at 15 members. KNOWN GAPS (deferred, out of scope): (1) crossing dashes in dense instrument regions over-merge into one component -> emitted as 'unresolved_signal_cluster' not a loop; (2) multi-bend signal routing (e.g. FIC-207's flow-transmitter inputs) is NOT recoverable by 2-segment probing — needs a dedicated multi-bend tracer; (3) mechanical shaft hierarchy K-V-201->GEAR->KM-V-201 needs manual annotation.
